account.title: Account & workspace
account.subtitle: Manage your password, workspace profile, storage usage and credit wallet summary.

password.title: Sign-in password
password.desc: Your current session stays active after updating; all other signed-in devices are signed out.
password.newPlaceholder: At least 10 characters with letters and digits
password.newHint: Use at least 10 characters with both letters and numbers.
password.success: Password updated. Your current session stays signed in and other devices were signed out.
password.errNewFormat: The new password must be at least 10 characters and include both letters and digits.
password.errSameAsCurrent: The new password cannot be the same as your current password.
password.errConfirmMismatch: The two new passwords do not match.
password.wrongCurrent: Current password is incorrect; password was not changed
password.wrongCurrentNext: Check your current password and try again. Your session remains active.

workspace.title: Workspace profile
workspace.desc: View your account email, workspace name and role; admins can rename the workspace inline.
workspace.memberReadonlyHint: Only workspace admins can rename the workspace.

usage.title: Workspace usage & wallet overview
usage.desc: Review document storage quota, workspace object counts and current credit balance.
usage.unavailableTitle: Could not load workspace usage right now
usage.unavailableNext: Try refreshing in a moment; other actions on this page remain available.

wallet.title: Credit wallet summary
wallet.desc: Live snapshot of available credits, held balance and bonus credits.
wallet.balanceNote: Paid balance {paid} credits (~${usd}) with {holds} active holds.

leave.title: Leave current workspace
leave.desc: After leaving, you will lose access to leads, campaigns and history in this workspace and your current session will end.
leave.confirmContent: After leaving "{name}", an admin must invite you again before you can rejoin.
leave.success: You have left the current workspace.

members.readonlyHint: You are signed in as a member and can browse the team roster; inviting, role changes and removal require an admin.

decisions.empty: No release or correction decisions have been recorded for this entry yet.
decisions.note: Suppression decisions are append-only. Release requests for legally protected entries are blocked automatically and kept in the audit trail.

reasonLabel.LEGAL_SUPPRESSION_PROTECTED: Legally protected and cannot be released
reasonLabel.LEGAL_PROTECTED: Legally protected and cannot be released

mirrors.title: Cascade cleanup receipts
mirrors.desc: Read-only log of local workspace cleanup receipts generated for data deletion requests (admins only).
mirrors.empty: No cascade cleanup receipts have been recorded yet.
mirrors.note: Receipts record cleanup counts and status only; no erased personal contact details are retained.
